# Third-party components

## 8086tiny
- Path: `third_party/8086tiny/8086tiny.c`
- Upstream: https://github.com/adriancable/8086tiny (Revision 1.25)
- Author: Adrian Cable (adrian.cable@gmail.com)
- License: MIT

The single-file PC XT emulator core has been adapted to remove the SDL
dependency and instead call the host callbacks declared in `host_interface.h`.
The instruction execution engine and PC peripheral emulation are unchanged
except for the graphics/keyboard/audio/output hooks noted in the source.

## CP437 8x8 bitmap font
- Path: `third_party/8086tiny/font8x8_cp437.h`
- Extracted from the Linux kernel VGA font `lib/fonts/font_8x8.c`
- License: GPL-2.0

Generated by `tools/gen_font.py` from `tools/font_8x8.c`. If a permissively
licensed CP437 font is required for a release build, replace this header with
an equivalent public-domain font (the 256-glyph data only, no kernel code).
